cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
줄파락 풀파티 완성!
입구 앞 다 모였으니
흑마님만 오면 바로 출발!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle dynamic three-quarter view of two party members waiting at the sandstone entrance step of Zul'Farrak on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, the Orc Warrior stands pumped up and eager, holding a one-handed war axe and a sturdy iron-rimmed shield, raising her chin confidently. On the right, the Night Elf Priest stands calmly with her healing staff resting lightly beside her on minimal desert sand pebbles, crisp 3-to-3.5 head-to-body Korean gag webtoon style.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
저 동부 왕국 스톰윈드예요.
배 타고 그리핀 갈아타면
30분 만에 가니까 기다려요!
cuts.visual_prompt: Wide eye-level shot of the Human Warlock lounging comfortably inside a Stormwind tavern corner on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background, her staff strapped across her back. Seated in the center on a wooden bench beside a small table holding a fantasy wooden tankard mug and an oval blue swirling-rune hearthstone, she waves one hand casually while her grumpy red imp sits beside a leather travel satchel on minimal wooden floorboards.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
반대편 대륙에서 왜 신청해?!
적어도 같은 대륙 여관에
귀환석이라도 박고 구해야지!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dramatic side-angled close-up on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background, with the Orc Warrior's one-handed axe and shield safely strapped onto her back so both hands are free. On the left, the Orc Warrior leans sharply forward in absolute disbelief, waving both fists angrily with comical sweatdrops and fury veins as she shouts. On the right, the Night Elf Priest stares blankly over the warrior's shoulder, quietly gripping her wooden staff with tired half-lidded eyes.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
그걸 왜 저한테 뭐라 해요?
파장님이 제 위치 미리 보고
초대하셨어야죠.
cuts.visual_prompt: Slightly high-angle wide shot of the Human Warlock standing innocently in the center on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background, with her staff stowed on her back. Tucking her grumpy red imp neatly under her left arm, she tilts her head serenely and points one index finger upward in a completely unapologetic lecturing pose with sparkling clueless eyes, a small travel satchel beside her boots on minimal cobblestone.

Deadpan symmetrical freeze-frame medium shot on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background showing total mental short-circuit. The Orc Warrior on the left and the Night Elf Priest on the right stand stiffly like stone statues with their weapons stowed on their backs, both staring straight ahead with hollow white blank eyes, slack open mouths, and tiny translucent white soul-wisps drifting upward from their heads.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
휴, 40분 걸렸네요~
근데 다들 안 흩어지고
계속 기다리신 거예요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Wide over-the-shoulder punchline shot on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background at the Zul'Farrak entrance. On the left, the Human Warlock trots in cheerfully and slightly out of breath with her staff strapped on her back and her tired red imp slumped on her shoulder, waving brightly. On the right, the Orc Warrior lies face-down and completely drained across minimal desert sand beside her sturdy shield and a half-empty hourglass, faint dizzy swirls hovering over her head.
